data_fields.name: tint_fits_tile_footprint
data_fields.donor_constant: sprite bounds inside tile rect (rule, no number)

best_idea: Batch same-colour tinted sprites into one pass, close the batch when its union box grows past twice its members' summed area, and close it before any flat tile so draw order is kept.
decision_why: The grouping rule (same colour, bounded union, flush on order break) fits client hit flash and status tint on up to three attackers, but the silhouette render-target path is SDL-specific and needs a measured win first.
acceptance: At 375 wide in a three-attacker fight, a hit flash on same-colour sprites draws in one pass with no rectangular seam, and a client test asserts that a flat tile between two complex tiles splits the batch.
